title: BRITA 35503 Standard Replacement Water Filter for Pitchers, 3 Count White

reviews.title: Good value for money!
reviews.body: Bought this back in december 2022 and used the 1st one today.. i bought the 6pc package and i would like to say that this product is as good as advertised and im happy with the value of the set i bought.. 1 filter for every 2months is a very good deal compared to buying drinking bottles everyday.. u will definitely save a lot of money using this filter.. if u have not used brita, please have a try and prepare to be amazed! Thanks seller and amazon!Edit: ordered again after 1 yr.. as usual, it came early and in good condition.. excellent product from brita.. after using it for a year, its definitely a recommended product! This will save u money if u actually buy a lot of bottled water like us before..
